docs.text: Happy to be back in Sault Ste. Marie this week for a series of stakeholder meetings at the Great Lakes Forestry Centre - Canadian Forest Service (NRCan). All about fire monitoring with satellites, fire danger, fire risk and management! I am usually remote from Ottawa, so this is a treat! 🔥🌲🌳🛰️📡🚒✈️🚁
